title: Munji language - Wikipedia
text: Munji language has 8 vowel phonemes, these are [ə], [a], [ɔ], [ʊ], [u], [ɪ], [ɛ], [i]. Five of these vowels are lengthened in pronunciation, [i], [u], [ɛ], [ɔ], [a]. And the three central vowels [ɪ], [ʊ], [ə] are pronounced as short.

title: Munji Phonological Analysis Introduction and Methodology
text: The Munji the Dari /me-/ prefix becomes /bɪ̆-/. In Dari, the /me-/ prefix is used to indicate progressive aspect, but as it moves to Munji it loses its status as a suffix and becomes part of the stem.
